title: Email notifications
description: Notification types, recipient emails and when each message is sent.

types.label: Application sent
types.description: The advisor has sent the application to the applicant to complete and sign.

types.label: Application pending
types.description: An application sent to the applicant is still pending completion and signature.

types.label: Application deleted
types.description: An incomplete advisor-prepared application has expired and been deleted. Both the advisor and applicant are notified.

types.label: Application completed
types.description: The applicant has completed and submitted the application.

types.label: Application edit requested
types.description: The applicant has requested an edit to the advisor-prepared application.
